[community-membership.md](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/community/blob/main/community-membership.md).
This issue tracks a promotion request once the requirements are met.

### Nomination

- Nominee GitHub username: `@`
- Nominated by (self-nomination is allowed): `@`
- Target role:
  - [ ] Reviewer
  - [ ] Approver
  - [ ] Maintainer
- Scope:
  - [ ] Main repository (Project-HAMi/HAMi)
  - [ ] Subproject — name: 
- OWNERS file that should carry the new entry (repo + path):

### Sponsors

Sponsor requirements differ by role and scope — main-repo promotions need
sponsors who are **maintainers** (2 for Reviewer/Approver), subproject
promotions need **1 maintainer** sponsor, and there must be no objections
from other approvers. Maintainer promotions follow the Maintainers-file
process described in community-membership.md.

- Sponsor 1: `@`
- Sponsor 2 (main-repo promotions only): `@`
- [ ] No objections from other approvers of the affected area

### Requirements checklist

- [ ] The nominee meets the requirements for the target role in community-membership.md
- [ ] For Reviewer: primary reviewer for at least 10 PRs (5 for a subproject) in the target codebase
- [ ] For Approver: has been a Reviewer of the codebase for at least 3 months and was primary reviewer for at least 10 substantial PRs
- [ ] For Maintainer: has been an Approver for at least 3 months and meets the Maintainer requirements in community-membership.md
